'''V'Sook M'Alra Vin''' was a [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] religious leader and member of [[j'ber V'Sook]]. V'Sook M'Alra Vin first preached the tenets of the religious movement that would become known as [[M'Nes]].
